title: Monthly audit memos & Flock Questions response
summary: The first ALPR-program PRA in this investigation. Asked for the monthly audit memoranda § 463.10 references and the audit process documentation. Resolved by email (not via the portal): SMPD produced three internal-audit memos (Nov/Dec 2025, Jan 2026) from Lt. Casazza to Capt. Barberini and a Flock Questions response describing the audit process.

policy_promises.quote: an audit is conducted of ALPR data searches at least monthly for internal ALPR users
policy_promises.tests: What monthly audit records exist, and what do they contain?

filed_because: Initial inquiry into what audit records the Department generates under its policy and how its audit process is structured.
notes: Portal case was staff-created and never formally closed via portal; the substantive exchange was by email with Kelly O'Keefe. Status set manually since the parser sees only a portal stub. Produced records are the foundation for W012461-040226 (which requested the same memos again after § 463.10 took effect) and subsequent audit-content PRAs.
